_comment: Colours for IMSA's past champion teams and makes that no team racing today colours, read by the Champions page (O34, lib/wp/endurance.ts) after the season's own cars and today's roster. Keys are the slugified name as champions.json writes it, without a trailing bracket (lib/slug.ts). A colour is taken only from a team or a make Paddock already colours today, named in `note` (the operator's answer P2, 18 Nov 2026); a name with no such match (Action Express Racing) stays grey. `note` is ignored by code.

whelen-engineering-racing.note: The #31 Cadillac Whelen's colour in Paddock's IMSA list (drivers.json); 2021.

whelen-cadillac-racing.note: The #31 Cadillac Whelen's colour in Paddock's IMSA list; 2023.

meyer-shank-racing.note: Acura Meyer Shank Racing's colour in Paddock's IMSA list; 2022.

chevrolet.note: Corvette Racing by Pratt Miller's colour in Paddock's IMSA list, Chevrolet's cars; the manufacturers' titles of 2014 to 2016.
